svg.text: How one alert moves through the system. Agents only read and recommend; code enforces the safety rules; humans decide risky cases.
From the SIEM: login, email, endpoint or cloud event
Plain-code regex scan for hidden instructions
Decides by itself which tools to call
Max 6 steps, then writes an evidence summary
Tools can only read, never change anything
Finds the 3 most relevant of 21 playbook sections
Real attack or false alarm? How serious?
Recommends an action from the playbook
Answer must match a strict JSON format
If agents disagree: keep the more serious view
If an injection was flagged: never auto-close
High or critical: always a human
injection flag goes straight to the safety rules
